opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to a signup link promising rewards up to $4,333, with larger amounts conditioned on depositing and trading. It describes up to $4,000 for making an initial deposit, transferring it into a USDT-margin futures account, and leaving it without withdrawal or transfer for five days. It also promotes a smaller coupon for completing KYC, which requires uploading photo identification and providing a physical address. Referral bonuses and crypto earning claims, including rates as high as 100% APY and possible profits of 20–30%, reinforce the low-barrier reward appeal. Although the narration acknowledges that users may lose money and the description discloses possible affiliate commissions, those qualifications do not remove the deposit, trading, and personal-information conditions; reward fulfillment and user outcomes remain unestablished.
